name: thruk-mcp
title: Thruk MCP Server
description: MCP server exposing the Thruk REST API (Naemon/Nagios/Icinga monitoring) to MCP-compatible LLM clients.

tools.name: thruk_list_hosts
tools.description: List monitored hosts. Filters: `hostgroup`, `state` (up/down/unreachable), `name_regex` (CI regex). Pagination: `limit` (max 1000), `offset`. Sort: `sort` (e.g. 'name', '-state'). Columns: by default a tight subset is returned to save tokens. Pass an empty string `columns=''` to return ALL columns, or a custom comma list.

tools.name: thruk_get_host
tools.description: Get a single host by name.

tools.name: thruk_list_services
tools.description: List monitored services. Filters: `host`, `servicegroup`, `state` (ok/warning/critical/unknown), `description_regex`. Pagination via `limit`/`offset`, sort via `sort` (e.g. '-last_state_change'). Default columns are a tight subset to save tokens; pass `columns=''` for all columns or a custom comma list.

tools.name: thruk_get_service
tools.description: Get a single service by host and description.

tools.name: thruk_list_hostgroups
tools.description: List host groups. Default columns return name/alias and host/service counts only.

tools.name: thruk_list_servicegroups
tools.description: List service groups. Default columns return name/alias and counts only.

tools.name: thruk_problems
tools.description: List all current unhandled host/service problems (not acknowledged, not in downtime). Sorted by worst state first. Default columns are tight; pass `columns=''` for all.

tools.name: thruk_stats
tools.description: Aggregated host/service statistics.

tools.name: thruk_list_downtimes
tools.description: List scheduled downtimes.

tools.name: thruk_get_downtime
tools.description: Get a single downtime by id.

tools.name: thruk_list_comments
tools.description: List comments (acknowledgements appear here too).

tools.name: thruk_sites
tools.description: List configured Thruk backends (sites).

tools.name: thruk_list_logs
tools.description: Query raw Livestatus log entries (/logs). Time arguments accept Thruk relative timestamps (e.g. '-24h', '-7d', '-30m') or absolute unix epoch. Default window: last 24h. Sort '-time' = newest first. Pagination via `limit`/`offset`. Default columns are a tight subset; pass `columns=''` for all columns.

tools.name: thruk_list_alerts
tools.description: List HOST/SERVICE ALERT entries from the log (/alerts). Optional `state` filters alert state: up/down/unreachable for hosts, ok/warning/critical/unknown for services.

tools.name: thruk_list_notifications
tools.description: List notification entries from the log (/notifications, class=3). Optional `contact` filters notifications sent to a specific contact name.

tools.name: thruk_recent_events
tools.description: Return the most recent monitoring events from the last N hours (default 1h). Defaults to all log classes; set `only_alerts=True` to restrict to HOST/SERVICE ALERT entries.

tools.name: thruk_query
tools.description: Escape hatch: call any Thruk REST endpoint. `path` is everything after `/thruk/r` (e.g. `/hosts/srv01/services`). `params` is the query string, `data` the form body. See https://www.thruk.org/documentation/rest.html for the full catalogue.

tools.name: thruk_run_background_query
tools.description: Run a potentially long Thruk REST request via the `background=1` mechanism. The server returns a job id immediately, then we poll `/thruk/jobs/<id>/output` until completion (default 5 min timeout). Use this for expensive queries: full config dumps, large availability reports, recursive config checks. Same `path` semantics as `thruk_query`.

tools.name: thruk_schedule_downtime
tools.description: Schedule a host or service downtime. Time accepts 'now', relative ('+2h', '+30m') or ISO 8601. If `duration_minutes` is set it overrides `end_time`.

tools.name: thruk_schedule_host_services_downtime
tools.description: Schedule a downtime on ALL services of the given host (schedule_host_svc_downtime). Use thruk_schedule_downtime for the host itself or for one specific service.

tools.name: thruk_schedule_propagated_host_downtime
tools.description: Schedule a downtime on a host and propagate to all child hosts. If `triggered=True`, child downtimes are triggered by the parent (start when the parent enters its downtime). Useful for a parent network device whose children should automatically follow.

tools.name: thruk_schedule_hostgroup_downtime
tools.description: Schedule a downtime for every host (`target='hosts'`, default) or every service (`target='services'`) of a hostgroup.

tools.name: thruk_schedule_servicegroup_downtime
tools.description: Schedule a downtime on a servicegroup. `target='services'` (default) targets all services in the group; `target='hosts'` targets the hosts owning those services.

tools.name: thruk_delete_downtime
tools.description: Delete a host or service downtime by its id.

tools.name: thruk_delete_active_downtimes
tools.description: Remove ALL currently active downtimes for a host (or one specific service when `service` is given). No need to know individual ids.

tools.name: thruk_delete_downtimes_by_filter
tools.description: Bulk-delete downtimes matching arbitrary filters via the system commands `del_downtime_by_host_name`, `del_downtime_by_hostgroup_name` or `del_downtime_by_start_time_comment`. At least one filter must be provided; the most specific endpoint is selected automatically.

tools.name: thruk_acknowledge
tools.description: Acknowledge a host or service problem.

tools.name: thruk_remove_acknowledgement
tools.description: Remove an acknowledgement.

tools.name: thruk_recheck
tools.description: Schedule an immediate (re)check for a host or service.
